records.title: Stable and low-precision training for large-scale vision-language models
records.reason: This paper studies low-precision VLM training stability, not inference-time compute or memory.

records.title: Understanding Multilingualism in Mixture-of-Experts LLMs: Routing Mechanism, Expert Specialization, and Layerwise Steering
records.reason: This primary study analyzes multilingual routing and uses steering interventions to improve language behavior; it does not reduce expert communication or inference work. The MoE lineage connection is analytical only.

records.title: A Silicon-Proven Unified Low-Latency CXL Controller and Port-Based Routing Switch for Memory-Centric Fabrics
records.reason: This paper designs a general CXL controller and routing switch; it does not evaluate or target LLM inference workloads.

records.title: Reasoning Traces Shape Outputs but Models Won't Say So
records.reason: The paper studies how reasoning traces affect generated outputs, not a method to reduce inference resources.

records.title: See More, Store Less: Memory-Efficient Resolution for Video Moment Retrieval
records.reason: The paper optimizes memory/resolution for video moment retrieval, a retrieval task; it does not establish LLM inference or video-LLM serving gains.
